fields.doc: Alpha >= this value counts as painted. Coverage ignores filtering, masks and occlusion.
fields.name: alpha_threshold

fields.doc: Top-down source-pixel grid spacing. Values above 1 mean an approximate report.
fields.name: pixel_step

fields.doc: Number of source pixel centers tested on the regular grid.
fields.name: sampled_pixels

fields.doc: Tested pixel centers covered by the union of UV triangles inside [0,1].
fields.name: covered_pixels

fields.doc: Covered centers whose source alpha is below the threshold.
fields.name: transparent_covered_pixels

fields.doc: Tested centers whose source alpha is at least the threshold.
fields.name: opaque_pixels

fields.doc: Opaque centers outside the UV triangle union: a contour coverage error, not a distance.
fields.name: uncovered_opaque_pixels

fields.doc: Transparent covered / covered; None if no tested center is covered.
fields.name: transparent_coverage_fraction

fields.doc: Uncovered opaque / opaque; None for an entirely transparent sampled image.
fields.name: uncovered_opaque_fraction

fields.doc: Number of UV triangles with vertices outside [0,1]; repeat-sampled coverage is not measured.
fields.name: out_of_bounds_triangles
targets

fields.doc: Draw triangle edges in cyan, in final evaluated model coordinates.
fields.name: wireframe

fields.doc: Draw vertex positions as yellow dots.
fields.name: vertices

fields.doc: Draw stable authoring vertex IDs in yellow, rather than transient array offsets.
fields.name: vertex_ids

fields.doc: Draw meshing boundary edges in green and internal constraints in magenta.
fields.name: constraints

fields.doc:
Fill triangles by symmetric edge stretch relative to the default pose: blue=1,
orange=2, red>=4; flipped or collapsed triangles are magenta.
fields.name: strain

fields.doc: Include disabled, hidden and zero-opacity meshes. Default draws visible meshes only.
fields.name: include_hidden

fields.doc: Clear the textured image before diagnostic drawing, retaining the exact same view.
fields.name: topology_only

fields.doc:
Heat fill opacity in [0,1]. Applied once per pixel using the most severe overlapping
triangle, so overlapping layers cannot accumulate opacity. Lines and labels stay opaque.
fields.name: heat_opacity

fields.doc:
Restrict every diagnostic layer to anomalous triangles and their incident vertices/edges.
Degenerate, flipped and undefined-reference triangles always count as anomalies.
fields.name: anomalies_only

fields.doc: Thresholds used by anomalies_only; reports themselves are never threshold-filtered.
fields.name: thresholds

fields.doc:
Decimal glyph scale in output pixels, 1..4. Labels avoid other labels globally;
an ID is omitted when no nearby in-view position has enough space.
fields.name: label_scale

fields.doc: Minimum clear gap between label rectangles in pixels, 0..32.
fields.name: label_spacing

fields.doc: Maximum labels per image, 0..4096. Vertex dots remain independent of this limit.
fields.name: max_labels

fields.doc: An angle below this value is anomalous; finite degrees in [0,60]. Default 10.
fields.name: min_angle_degrees

fields.doc: A longest-edge/altitude ratio above this is anomalous; finite and >= 1. Default 20.
fields.name: max_aspect_ratio

fields.doc: A symmetric edge-length ratio above this is anomalous; finite and >= 1. Default 2.
fields.name: max_edge_stretch

fields.doc: Owned explicit view shared by these ordered frames.
fields.name: view

fields.doc: Owned requested parameter maps in input order, including duplicates.
fields.name: requested

fields.doc: Rendered frames in requested pose order, sharing one resolved texture acquisition.
fields.name: frames

fields.doc: Output image width in pixels.
fields.name: width

fields.doc: Output image height in pixels.
fields.name: height

fields.doc: Raw renderer RGBA8, row-major, top-left image origin. Renderer alpha convention is preserved.
fields.name: rgba

fields.doc: PNG encoding of exactly the returned RGBA8; encoded by Rust, never by Python.
fields.name: png

fields.doc: Captured authoring document UUID.
fields.name: document_id

fields.doc: Captured geometry evaluation revision, distinct from the outer formal/candidate Source.
fields.name: evaluation_revision

fields.doc: Shared acquisition UUID for this batch's once-resolved immutable texture set.
fields.name: capture_id

fields.doc: Digest of captured evaluated geometry, authoring records and resolved texture content.
fields.name: scene_digest

fields.doc: Digest of the exact source scene and explicit rendering settings.
fields.name: render_digest

fields.doc: Renderer hash of evaluated input, texture content and output view.
fields.name: input_sha256

fields.doc: Actual GPU adapter name, obtained only when a render executes.
fields.name: adapter_name

fields.doc: Actual renderer backend, Metal on macOS or the selected WGPU backend elsewhere.
fields.name: adapter_backend

fields.doc: Effective evaluated parameters keyed by stable document UUID.
fields.name: parameters

fields.doc: Actual viewport model extent [min_x,min_y,max_x,max_y], including aspect-ratio expansion.
fields.name: visible_roi

fields.doc: Model-to-image scale. Image X=x*scale+offset[0], Y=-y*scale+offset[1].
fields.name: scale

fields.doc: Translation in top-left image pixels, parallel to the documented scale formula.
fields.name: offset

fields.doc: Source texture identities and exact content hashes shared across this batch.
fields.name: textures

fields.doc: Drawable geometric image bounds in evaluated order; masks/occlusion are not pixel-tested here.
fields.name: drawable_bounds

fields.doc:
Mesh quality in evaluated drawable order when View.quality is true; empty otherwise.
Texture coverage uses alpha >= 8, pixel centers, at most a 256x256 grid, ignoring masks,
filtering and UV repeat outside [0,1]. A step above 1 denotes approximate coverage.
fields.name: quality

fields.doc: Output width in pixels, 1..4096, subject to device and Runtime budgets.
fields.name: width

fields.doc: Output height in pixels, 1..4096, subject to device and Runtime budgets.
fields.name: height

fields.doc: Nonempty finite [min_x,min_y,max_x,max_y] in Y-up model coordinates.
fields.name: roi

fields.doc: Nonnegative padding around the ROI in model units; aspect ratio is preserved.
fields.name: padding_model

fields.doc:
Optional topology overlay in the same frozen Source and ROI mapping. It ignores
masks and occlusion; None preserves the ordinary GPU image.
fields.name: topology

fields.doc:
Include per-mesh evaluated quality and approximate source-alpha coverage.
Uses default parameters of the same source as reference; checks requested frames only.
fields.name: quality

fields.doc: Stable authoring drawable UUID.
fields.name: id

fields.doc: Evaluated visibility; geometric bounds do not prove unoccluded painted pixels.
fields.name: visible

fields.doc: Clipped image bounds [min_x,min_y,max_x,max_y], exclusive maximum; None if empty.
fields.name: bounds

fields.doc: Stable asset UUID resolved from the frozen authoring source.
fields.name: asset_id

fields.doc: SHA256 of the exact immutable texture content uploaded by this capture.
fields.name: sha256
